name: jarble-dev Phase 5 — Team Orchestration (Hierarchical Agent Trees)
description: Add Claude-style agent teams to jarble-dev. Plans can define teams (sub-orchestrators) that run their own task groups in parallel, with cross-team context forwarding and hierarchical merging. This is the tree-of-orchestrators architecture.

tasks.name: team-types
tasks.description: Add all types, interfaces, and plan format support for team orchestration.

tasks.name: team-orchestrator
tasks.description: Create the TeamOrchestrator class that manages team-level execution, spawning child orchestrators for each team.

tasks.name: team-presets
tasks.description: Create pre-configured team presets for common Jarble platform domains (schema, backend, frontend, mcp, tests).

tasks.name: team-plan-validator
tasks.description: Extend the PlanValidator to validate team plans — check team deps, budget, agent types, and validate each team's internal tasks.

tasks.name: team-cli
tasks.description: Add CLI commands for team orchestration: team-run, team-init, team-plan. Update validate to support team plans.

tasks.name: team-tests
tasks.description: Write tests for team orchestration: TeamOrchestrator, team presets, team plan validation.
tasks.prompt:
You are writing tests for the jarble-dev team orchestration feature.

Read these files first:
- jarble-dev/src/teamOrchestrator.ts
- jarble-dev/src/teamPresets.ts
- jarble-dev/src/planValidator.ts (the validateTeamPlan method)
- jarble-dev/src/types.ts (TeamDef, TeamPlan, TeamState, etc.)
- jarble-dev/vitest.config.ts (test config)
- jarble-dev/src/__tests__/ (existing test files for patterns)

## Create 3 test files:

### jarble-dev/src/__tests__/teamPresets.test.ts:
- All presets have required fields (name, description, defaultBudget, scope)
- All preset agent types are valid (exist in the known agent list)
- listTeamPresets() returns all preset names
- getTeamPreset() returns correct preset by name
- getTeamPreset() returns undefined for unknown name
- Each preset has at least one example task
- Example tasks have valid touchesFiles paths

### jarble-dev/src/__tests__/teamPlanValidator.test.ts:
- Valid team plan passes validation
- Missing plan name produces error
- Empty teams array produces error
- Missing team name produces error
- Unknown team dependency produces error
- Circular team dependencies detected
- Invalid agent type produces error
- Invalid permission mode produces error
- Internal task validation runs (missing prompt in a team's task)
- High budget warning
- Valid complex plan with 4 teams and deps passes

### jarble-dev/src/__tests__/teamOrchestrator.test.ts:
- validateTeamDeps() catches circular dependencies
- validateTeamDeps() catches unknown team references
- validateTeamDeps() passes valid deps
- buildTeamContext() returns null when no dep diffs
- buildTeamContext() includes dep diffs when available
- buildTeamContext() truncates long diffs

Note: Testing the full run() method requires mocking Orchestrator, which is complex.
Focus on testing the pure logic methods. For run(), just verify it throws on circular deps.

Mock the Logger class for all tests:
```typescript
const mockLogger = {
  info: vi.fn(), warn: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn(), debug: vi.fn(),
  agent: vi.fn(), merge: vi.fn(), quality: vi.fn(),
  agentLog: vi.fn(), getAgentStream: vi.fn(),
  summary: vi.fn(), close: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
} as any;
```

IMPORTANT:
- Read existing test files in __tests__/ for the testing patterns used
- Use vi.mock() for module mocking, vi.fn() for function mocks
- Run `cd jarble-dev && npm test` at the end to verify all tests pass (old and new)
- Fix any failures before committing
- Commit with message: 'test(jarble-dev): add team orchestration tests'
